name: Naturally Dried Lotus Pod
description:
Naturally dried lotus seed pods for vivarium and terrarium hardscape. The distinctive honeycomb seed chambers add bold organic texture and a sculptural focal point to planted setups, mossariums, and woodland-themed layouts.

Product Features:
• 100% natural dried lotus pod
• Open seed chambers create unique visual depth and shadow
• Lightweight and easy to place among moss, wood, and substrate
• Ideal for vivariums, terrariums, paludariums, and decorative plant displays
• Each pod is unique in shape, tone, and chamber pattern

Size:
Diameter approx. 8–10 cm

Ideal For:
Naturalistic hardscape accents, miniature forest scenes, and statement botanical décor inside planted enclosures.

Note: Natural product — exact size, color, and form may vary slightly. Spot-clean as needed; replace if mould develops in high-humidity setups.
